subject: [shiny server] Keep R session always running to avoid initialization delay

messages.author: 7a2765b6c9033e73
messages.subject: [shiny server] Keep R session always running to avoid initialization delay
parts:
Hi!

We're developing a Shiny app and hosting it with Shiny Server Pro. In my experiments I can see a new R session gets started when a new client connects but it's automatically terminated when the client disconnects and there aren't any other clients.
This is problematic for us because the initialization code for our app is quite slow (see server.R below).

//server.R

data <- loadData() //takes a few seconds to load
library(mypackage) //takes a few seconds to load

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  //fast
}

Is there a way to keep the R session always running so new connections don't experience the delay of initializing the app?

Thanks!

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: [shiny server] Keep R session always running to avoid initialization delay
parts:
You can increase the idle timeout by adding something like the following in your shiny-server.conf file:

app_idle_timeout 3600;

Please refer to this section of Admin Guide for more info:
http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#application-timeouts

Best,
Fereshteh

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: [shiny server] Keep R session always running to avoid initialization delay
parts:
The maximum value you could set is something in the range of less than 24.9 days. This is a limitation of node.js. So a value such as 2147483 should work.

Currently setting app_idle_timeout 0; does not disable the timeout; but we will fix this problem for future releases.
